items.title: A Day
items.reason: A surgeon repeatedly relives the day his daughter dies, then discovers another man is trapped in the same loop. Their attempts to change events turn an apparent traffic accident into an investigation of why the loop exists, who the taxi driver really is, how a three-year-old hit-and-run and an unethical heart transplant connect the victims, and what must change to end the cycle. The film keeps adding causal information and reframing the deaths rather than relying on the time-loop premise alone.
